title: Autospec explore proposal
description: A single feature proposal emitted by an autospec-explore researcher and carried through the research-cycle aggregator. Extends the base contract (title/evidence/estimated_complexity/confidence/source) with the severity band and named_consumer fields introduced by the discovery-enhance batch.

severity.description: Impact band, highest to lowest: silent-wrong > correctness > stability > operability > feature > nicety. The enum order is load-bearing — it is the primary ranking key. Legacy researchers that omit this field are defaulted to `feature` by the aggregator.

named_consumer.description: Free text naming a skill/workflow/operator step that benefits from this proposal today. Empty string means no named consumer; new-source proposals with an empty value are dropped by the ROI gate (Issue C). Legacy researchers that omit this field are defaulted to "" by the aggregator and are NOT auto-dropped.

gap_check.description: Optional machine-checkable claim the deterministic gap-confirmation stage (between dedup and verify) re-verifies against current files before the proposal is ranked. `absent`: needle is claimed MISSING from haystack — dropped if found. `present`: needle is claimed to EXIST in haystack — dropped if absent. Any proposal carrying a gap_check is verified; additionally, proposals from a gap-claiming source (default: source-analysis/self-leverage, configurable via AUTOSPEC_EXPLORE_GAP_CLAIMING_SOURCES) that omit gap_check are refuted by default.

needle.description: Fixed string searched for (not a regex). For kind=absent it is the thing claimed missing; for kind=present it is the call-site/pattern claimed to exist.

haystack.description: Repo-relative file, glob, or the literal "<repo>" for a repo-wide git grep. Must resolve inside the repository (no absolute paths, no `..` escape).

priority.description: When true, the aggregator applies AUTOSPEC_PRIORITY_BOOST (default 1.5) to this proposal's score before ranking, bounded so it cannot exceed max_non_boosted_score * multiplier. Proposals with source=="steer" are also treated as priority-aligned.
